description: Built 1944 and first based at Fairfield-Suisun Army Air Base (now Travis AFB). Combat veteran of the Second World War with the 316th Troop Carrier Group in Europe shortly after Operation Market Garden. Appeared in the 1952 film "Above and Beyond" according to Simon B. Deck; "The Aircraft-Spotter's Film and Television Companion". Delivered to the FAS in July 1974 and still on active inventory when the armed conflict began in 1980; from late September 1988 used as a test-bed; and in January 1990 erected as the "Monumento a los Paracaidistas" facing the east entrance of Ilopango Air Base. During installation a crane cable failed and one wing fell to the ground; without injuries. The gear stayed retracted from 1990 until the earthquake of 13 January 2001 shook it into the down-and-locked position; where it remains.
